description: With Atoll's own view, the SSD cache does what it says: the preset energy turns cache.enabled on for a disk with the role cache, and neither gets a warning.
config:
strategy = "energy"
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
engine = "atoll"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "c1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/c1"
fs = "ext4"
role = "cache"
